blind.second_guess: stack of rolled maps or firewood
blind.description: A small messy stack of rolled parchment paper scrolls tied with dark red ribbons. The scrolls feature rolled paper ends with spiral details, with one unrolling slightly along the edge. The surfaces are smooth, solid, and stylized with clean geometry. The pile rests directly on the floor without an added base or plinth.
blind.from_above: A compact rectangular cluster of rolled paper cylinders bundled with red cross-bands/ribbons.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1/8 to 1/7 the height of the figure (about 8-10 inches tall) and about 1.5 feet wide.
